208000.name: Inside The Western Gate Of Mishrak

east.description: To the east lies The Western Wall Road Meets Chapel Street.

west.description: To the west lies Outside the Gate of Kashmir.

208000.description:
Within the western gate the road passes through a vaulted passage, its
walls rough with soot and its floor rutted by countless cart wheels. A
barred wicket stands set in the great door, and a portcullis hangs
raised in its slot above. The gate stands open to the west, leading out
to the trade road beyond, and the wall road lies east. A gatekeeper's
brazier smoulders in a niche.

208001.name: The Western Wall Road Meets The Southern Wall Road

north.description: To the north lies The Western Wall Road.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Wall Road Meets Barracks Avenue.

208001.description:
Two stretches of the wall road meet at this rounded corner, and a flight
of worn steps climbs the wall to a narrow walkway above. Rain has pooled
in the angle where the stones meet, and an old brazier stands rusted
beside it. The road goes north along the town wall and east into the
covered passage toward Barracks Avenue. Chimneys smoke raggedly beyond
the wall-backed houses.

208002.name: The Western Wall Road

north.description: To the north lies The Western Wall Road.

south.description: To the south lies The Western Wall Road Meets The Southern Wall Road.

down.description: To the down lies The Hole.

208002.description:
A hole has opened in the middle of the wall road, a ragged gap in the
cobbles where something below has given way, ringed by stakes and a
single length of tattered rope. The edges crumble when the wind blows
and a smell of old earth rises out of it. The road continues north and
south, and a rough ledge leads down into the pit. Windows overlook the
spot and every shutter is closed.

208003.name: The Western Wall Road

north.description: To the north lies The Western Wall Road Meets Chapel Street.

south.description: To the south lies The Western Wall Road.

208003.description:
The wall road runs straight and quiet here beneath the curtain wall,
whose stones are streaked with ochre stains where iron ties have rusted.
Doors in the house fronts are barred and each lintel carries a nailed
bunch of dried herbs against the dark. A bell from the chapel tolls
somewhere ahead. The road leads north to a junction under a gallery and
south toward the corner.

8004.name: The Western Wall Road Meets Chapel Street

north.description: To the north lies The Western Wall Road Meets Keep Street.

east.description: To the east lies Chapel Street.

south.description: To the south lies The Western Wall Road.

west.description: To the west lies Inside The Western Gate Of Mishrak.

8004.description:
The street runs beneath the jutting upper floor of a chandler's house,
so the junction lies in permanent dusk and smells of old rope and wet
stone. Ways open on every side: the wall road goes north toward Keep
Street and south along the town wall, Chapel Street heads east, and west
stands the western gate itself. A rusted lantern hook hangs from a beam,
long without a lantern. Behind bolted shutters someone coughs, and the
chapel bell tolls the quarter hour.

8005.name: The Western Wall Road Meets Keep Street

north.description: To the north lies The Western Wall Road.

east.description: To the east lies Keep Street.

south.description: To the south lies The Western Wall Road Meets Chapel Street.

8005.description:
Keep Street ends here against the wall road, a crooked meeting of
cobbles worn into shallow troughs by cartwheels. The grey curtain wall
climbs on one side, its parapet lost in drifting mist, while the road
continues north and south and Keep Street leads east between tall narrow
houses. A drain grate gurgles beside the kerb. Every window along the
lane has its shutter pulled to, and a few have been nailed.

8006.name: The Western Wall Road

north.description: To the north lies The Western Wall Road.

south.description: To the south lies The Western Wall Road Meets Keep Street.

8006.description:
The wall road follows the foot of the town wall, which rises here in
rough courses of dark stone patched with newer, paler blocks. Puddles
stand between the setts and reflect nothing but cloud. Small houses
press close on the inner side, their doors painted with chalk signs that
someone has tried to scrub away. The road goes north and south from
here.

8007.name: The Western Wall Road

north.description: To the north lies The Western Wall Road Meets The Northern Wall Road.

south.description: To the south lies The Western Wall Road.

8007.description:
A leaning buttress braces the town wall at this point, and the road
bends around it, narrow enough that two carts would have to quarrel.
Moss furs the lower stones and a trickle of rainwater runs down a crack
in the masonry. Smoke from a hidden chimney lies flat over the roofs.
The road runs on north to a corner and back south the way you came.

8008.name: The Western Wall Road Meets The Northern Wall Road

east.description: To the east lies The Northern Wall Road.

south.description: To the south lies The Western Wall Road.

8008.description:
Two stretches of wall road meet at a sharp corner, where the old wall
turns and a squat watch-post stands with its door hanging open on empty
gloom. Wind gathers in the angle and carries the damp smell of the moat
or whatever lies beyond the stones. Your way follows the Northern Wall
Road east, or back south along the road you came by. A bell sounds
slowly from the chapel, the only voice in the street.

8009.name: The Southern Wall Road Meets Barracks Avenue

north.description: To the north lies Barracks Avenue.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Wall Road.

west.description: To the west lies The Western Wall Road Meets The Southern Wall Road.

8009.description:
A vaulted passage carries the wall road under the barracks' overhanging
wing, and the ceiling bricks are black with generations of torch smoke.
Racks of staves and spear shafts stand against the stone, bound with
leather thongs. Barracks Avenue runs north from here into the garrison's
quarter, the road continues east, and a short way west lies a corner of
the wall road. Boots ring somewhere above on bare boards.

8010.name: Barracks Avenue

north.description: To the north lies Mishrak Civil Barracks.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Wall Road Meets Barracks Avenue.

8010.description:
Barracks Avenue is a covered lane, roofed over by the upper floors of
the garrison buildings, and lamps hang from iron brackets at every few
paces. The flagstones are scrubbed grey and the walls whitewashed to
shoulder height, scuffed by passing shields. A heavy door stands to the
north, studded with nails and marked with the crest of the town watch.
South the passage opens back into the wall road.

8011.name: Mishrak Civil Barracks

east.description: To the east lies Mishrak Civil Barracks Headquarters.

south.description: To the south lies Barracks Avenue.

8011.description:
The barracks hall is long and low, with bare timber rafters, rows of
narrow cots made up with grey blankets, and a rack of dented helms by
the wall. A stove sits cold in the middle of the floor, ringed with
boot-black. Stale air smells of oil, sweat and old wool. An iron-bound
door in the end of the hall leads east to the headquarters, and the door
out to Barracks Avenue lies south.

8012.name: Chapel Street

east.description: To the east lies Chapel Street.

west.description: To the west lies The Western Wall Road Meets Chapel Street.

8012.description:
The covered street is quiet here, hung with strings of dried herbs and
bunches of withered holly nailed over each door. Cobbles run smooth and
grey underfoot, and the roof beams are black from years of lamp smoke.
Somewhere a latch clicks softly and a shutter shuts. Chapel Street runs
east toward the chapel and west toward the wall road.

8013.name: Keep Street

north.description: To the north lies Keep Street.

west.description: To the west lies The Western Wall Road Meets Keep Street.

8013.description:
Keep Street heads toward the wall here, its houses lower and meaner,
with cracked plaster and slates missing from their roofs. A line of
washing hangs stiff and grey between two windows, dripping slowly. The
cobbles shine with the damp. The street goes north and west from this
bend.

8014.name: Keep Street

north.description: To the north lies The Office.

east.description: To the east lies Keep Street.

south.description: To the south lies Keep Street.

8014.description:
Keep Street meets a short doorway to the north, with a plank door
painted dark green and a brass plate gone black. A well-worn step shows
where many visitors have waited in the damp. The street continues east
and south from here. Fine rain beads on the iron lamp bracket overhead.

8015.name: Guard Room

north.description: To the north lies The Northern Wall Road.

8015.description:
A small bare chamber serves as the watch's guard room, with a bench
along the wall and a table scarred with knife marks. A cracked lamp
swings from a chain and a pegboard holds keys and rusted manacles. A
narrow slit of window shows the wall road outside. The door north leads
back out to the road.

8016.name: The Northern Wall Road

east.description: To the east lies The Northern Wall Road.

south.description: To the south lies Guard Room.

west.description: To the west lies The Western Wall Road Meets The Northern Wall Road.

8016.description:
The Northern Wall Road runs straight beneath the parapet, its cobbles
slick with last night's fog. A heavy door in the house fronts opens on
the Guard Room to the south, iron-banded and scarred by old knife work.
The road continues east into grey distance and west to the corner. Spent
torch stubs lie in a gutter, and a rattle of shutters announces that
someone has seen you pass.

8017.name: The Southern Wall Road

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Wall Road.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Wall Road Meets Barracks Avenue.

8017.description:
Barracks Avenue lies close by, and the wall road shows its mark in boot-
scuffed cobbles and the faint smell of wet leather and lamp oil. A water
trough stands by the wall, its iron ring rusted but sturdy. High above,
a sentry's lantern swings in the wind. The road goes east along the wall
and west to where Barracks Avenue meets it.

8018.name: Western Altar

east.description: To the east lies The Chapel Of Mishrak.

8018.description:
The western altar is a plain stone table beneath a small round window of
smoked glass, its surface scrubbed bare and faintly stained. Iron rings
are set in the wall behind it, and the flagstones before it are dished
by kneelers. A thin smell of incense and copper lingers. The only way
back is east into the aisle.

8019.name: Mishrak Civil Barracks Headquarters

west.description: To the west lies Mishrak Civil Barracks.

8019.description:
The headquarters is a bare, cramped chamber, dominated by a scarred oak
table covered in maps and duty rolls weighted with spent arrowheads.
Pegs along the walls hold cloaks and chains, and a lantern burns with a
tired, smoky flame. A crossed pair of pikes hangs above the cold hearth.
The only way out is the door west into the barracks hall.

8020.name: Chapel Street

east.description: To the east lies Chapel Street Meets Market Street.

west.description: To the west lies Chapel Street.

8020.description:
Chapel Street runs beneath a long roof of dark timbers, with shuttered
stalls and boarded doorways pressed against its sides. A single lamp
burns on an iron hook, throwing wavering shadows on the damp walls. The
pavement is polished by processions that no longer come. The street
leads east toward the chapel forecourt and west toward the wall road.

8021.name: Mishrak Marketplace

east.description: To the east lies Market Street.

8021.description:
The marketplace is an open square of wet cobbles, with rows of empty
stalls under sagging awnings, their trestles bare and their canvas
spotted with mould. A stone fountain in the middle runs dry, its basin
filled with leaves. Cold wind pulls at the awnings and rattles the
hooks. Market Street leads back east.

8022.name: Keep Street

east.description: To the east lies Keep Street Meets Market Street.

west.description: To the west lies Keep Street.

8022.description:
Keep Street runs level here between narrow houses of timber and plaster,
whose upper floors lean over the cobbles until they almost touch. A
cracked lamp hangs unlit over the doorway of a closed cooper's shop.
Dripping gutters beat a slow rhythm on stone. The street goes east
toward the crossroads and west toward the wall road.

8023.name: A Ruined House

north.description: To the north lies The Northern Wall Road.

down.description: To the down lies The Cellar.

8023.description:
The house has lost most of its roof, and rafters stand against the sky
like blackened ribs. Doors hang from their hinges, and the floor is a
heap of charred beams, tiles and scorched plaster. Nettles grow through
the hearth and the smell of old smoke still lingers. A hatch in the
floor leads down into the cellar, and a doorway opens north onto the
wall road.

8024.name: The Northern Wall Road

east.description: To the east lies The Northern Wall Road.

south.description: To the south lies A Ruined House.

west.description: To the west lies The Northern Wall Road.

8024.description:
Weeds push up between the setts of the Northern Wall Road, and the
houses along it grow shabbier as the road goes east. To the south a door
hangs crooked in the frame of a ruined house, its roof half fallen in
and its windows black. A cold draught breathes from it, smelling of soot
and rot. The road goes on east and back west.

8025.name: The Southern Wall Road

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Wall Road.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Wall Road.

8025.description:
The Southern Wall Road lies deserted, its paving broken by frost, and
the town wall leans slightly inward as if listening. Torn bills nailed
to a doorpost flap in the wind, their ink run to grey blots. Smoke and
damp mingle in the air. The road continues east and west.

8026.name: The Chapel Of Mishrak

north.description: To the north lies The Chapel Of Mishrak.

east.description: To the east lies The Chapel Of Mishrak.

west.description: To the west lies Western Altar.

down.description: To the down lies The Secret Room.

8026.description:
The chapel's western aisle is lined with narrow arched alcoves holding
worn stone saints whose faces have been chiselled smooth. One flagstone
in the floor has been scraped at the edges and set slightly askew, as
though lifted and replaced many times. Cold air seeps from the crack.
Aisles lead north and east, and an arch leads west to an altar.

8027.name: The Chapel Of Mishrak

north.description: To the north lies Chapel Street Meets Market Street.

east.description: To the east lies The Chapel Of Mishrak.

south.description: To the south lies The Chapel Of Mishrak.

8027.description:
The nave of the chapel is hushed and cold, with a long aisle of worn
flagstones and rows of plain oak benches facing a distant altar. Grey
light seeps through narrow windows of dull glass. Candle stubs gutter in
iron stands, and the smell of tallow and damp stone is strong. The doors
north lead out to the street, while the nave continues east and south.

8028.name: Chapel Street Meets Market Street

north.description: To the north lies Market Street.

east.description: To the east lies Chapel Street Meets Market Street.

south.description: To the south lies The Chapel Of Mishrak.

west.description: To the west lies Chapel Street.

8028.description:
Chapel Street and Market Street meet in a roofed forecourt before the
chapel, where lamps hang from chains and the pillars wear a coat of
soot. A pair of tall doors stands to the south, bound in iron and carved
with an ancient pattern of thorns. Market Street leads north and Chapel
Street west. The bell above tolls with a deep, slow note that shakes the
dust.

8029.name: Market Street

north.description: To the north lies Keep Street Meets Market Street.

south.description: To the south lies Chapel Street Meets Market Street.

west.description: To the west lies Mishrak Marketplace.

8029.description:
Market Street slopes toward the square, its cobbles scattered with
cabbage leaves and straw and the faint tang of fish brine. Tall narrow
shops with painted signs line either side, each shuttered and hung with
a bell. A gutter running down the middle carries a thread of grey water.
The street goes north to a crossroads, south toward the chapel, and west
opens into the marketplace.

8030.name: Keep Street Meets Market Street

north.description: To the north lies Mishrak Stables.

east.description: To the east lies The Entrance To Mishrak Keep.

south.description: To the south lies Market Street.

west.description: To the west lies Keep Street.

8030.description:
A crossroads of Keep Street and Market Street, where wheel ruts have
worn the cobbles into deep grooves and a signpost stands with arms
pointing in four directions. A stable door stands in the wall to the
north, the keep's gate arch is near east, and Market Street runs south.
Another reach of Keep Street goes west. The smell of hay and horse hangs
in the damp air.

8031.name: Mishrak Stables

south.description: To the south lies Keep Street Meets Market Street.

8031.description:
The stables are an open yard surrounded by low sheds, the straw
underfoot trodden into a brown mat and the beams above black with old
smoke. Wooden stalls stand empty, their halters dangling from pegs. A
pump drips into a mossy trough. The only way out is the door south to
Keep Street.

8032.name: The Northern Wall Road

east.description: To the east lies The Northern Wall Road.

west.description: To the west lies The Northern Wall Road.

8032.description:
Here the Northern Wall Road runs between the battlemented wall and a row
of blind brick backs, with not a single door in them. Rain has streaked
the stonework with long dark tracks, and a broken pitchfork rests
against a wall where somebody left it. The only sounds are the wind over
the parapet and distant hammering. East and west the road continues.

8033.name: The Southern Wall Road

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Wall Road.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Wall Road.

8033.description:
Behind the wall road the houses rise in tiers of dark slate roofs, and
the cobbles here are patched with flat river stones. A rain barrel
overflows into the gutter and nobody comes to mend it. A small shrine
niche in the wall holds a stub of candle, still burning. The Southern
Wall Road runs east and west.

8034.name: The Chapel Of Mishrak

north.description: To the north lies The Chapel Of Mishrak.

east.description: To the east lies Eastern Altar.

west.description: To the west lies The Chapel Of Mishrak.

8034.description:
This side of the chapel is a bare alcove of stone and old wood, with a
bench along the wall and a worn grating in the floor that breathes cold
air. Candle wax has dripped in rivulets down the nearest pillar. The
sound of the bell fills the vault above. Aisles lead north and west, and
a low arch opens east to an altar.

8035.name: The Chapel Of Mishrak

north.description: To the north lies Head Priest's Quarters.

south.description: To the south lies The Chapel Of Mishrak.

west.description: To the west lies The Chapel Of Mishrak.

8035.description:
Here the nave bends toward the chancel, where a simple altar rail of
black wood divides the pews from a worn step. Heavy drapes hang
motionless, and a lamp burns red in a hanging cup. The stone floor is
dished by centuries of kneeling. A door north leads to the head priest's
rooms, the nave continues south, and an aisle goes west.

8036.name: Head Priest's Quarters

south.description: To the south lies The Chapel Of Mishrak.

8036.description:
The head priest's quarters are a plain, cold chamber with a narrow bed,
a writing desk heaped with sealed letters and a prie-dieu worn smooth at
the knee. A tall cupboard stands closed beside a hearth that holds only
grey ash. The window shows a slice of slate roofs and drifting cloud.
The only door leads south to the chapel.

8037.name: Bottom Of The Narrow Stairs

north.description: To the north lies Mishrak Keep.

up.description: To the up lies A Long Hallway.

8037.description:
A narrow stair begins here in a cramped lobby of cold flagstones, its
steps worn in the middle by countless feet. A single rushlight burns in
a niche, trailing a thin black thread of smoke. The air is stale, and
echoes of your steps return from above. The door north leads back to the
court, and the stairs go up into the keep.

8038.name: Mishrak Keep

north.description: To the north lies The Entrance To Mishrak Keep.

south.description: To the south lies Bottom Of The Narrow Stairs.

8038.description:
The keep's inner court is a paved square pent in by high grey walls, its
sky a strip of cloud above. A dry well stands in the middle, its
windlass rotted away, and weeds grow along the base of the walls. Arrow
slits stare down from every side. The gate arch lies north, and a heavy
door south opens to a narrow stair.

extra_descs.well windlass:
The well is dry, its shaft a black circle edged with green slime, and
the windlass above it has rotted off its pins. A faint chill rises from
the depths.

8039.name: The Entrance To Mishrak Keep

north.description: To the north lies Guard Room.

east.description: To the east lies Keep Street.

south.description: To the south lies Mishrak Keep.

west.description: To the west lies Keep Street Meets Market Street.

8039.description:
Before you rise the keep's inner gate, an arched entrance flanked by two
stout buttresses, with an iron grille raised on its chains above. Cold
air breathes from the dark archway, and the paving has been worn bright
by the boots of soldiers. A guard room door stands north, the keep's
inner court lies south, Keep Street runs east, and another street leads
west. Torch sconces hold only charred stubs.

8040.name: Guard Room

south.description: To the south lies The Entrance To Mishrak Keep.

8040.description:
The guard room is a stone cell with a low vaulted ceiling, a rack of
spears along one wall and a battered table scattered with dice and
scraps of tallow. A narrow window looks out on the gate arch. The hearth
is cold and the benches smell of cheap ale and old leather. The only
door leads south to the gate.

8041.name: The Northern Wall Road

east.description: To the east lies The Northern Wall Road.

west.description: To the west lies The Northern Wall Road.

8041.description:
A single gnarled tree grows from a gap in the paving by the wall, bare
of leaves and strung with rags of faded cloth that townsfolk have tied
to its twigs. Beneath the tree the stones are stained with old candle
wax. Plain shuttered houses face the wall on the other side of the road.
The Northern Wall Road carries on east and west.

extra_descs.tree rags cloth:
The rags are strips torn from shirts, shrouds and bed linen, each tied
by someone with a wish or a grief. The oldest have rotted to threads.

8042.name: The Southern Wall Road

east.description: To the east lies The Eastern Wall Road Meets The Southern Wall Road.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Wall Road.

down.description: To the down lies The Hole.

8042.description:
The Southern Wall Road passes a black hole sunk into the cobbles by the
wall, rimmed with broken paving and fenced with a crooked rail. A chill,
earthy breath comes up from it along with a faint, sweet rot. The road
goes on east to the corner and west along the town wall. Steps of rough
stone lead down into the dark.

8043.name: Eastern Altar

west.description: To the west lies The Chapel Of Mishrak.

north.description: To the north lies The Abode Of Donnchadh.

8043.description:
A small side altar stands against the wall, draped in a grey cloth
embroidered with a faded sign of thorns. Two candlesticks of tarnished
brass flank it, and a bowl of dry salt rests beside them. The stone slab
is stained with old rings where cups once stood. The only way back is
west into the transept.

extra_descs.altar cloth thorns sign:
The grey cloth is embroidered in black thread with a ring of thorns, the
old sign of Mishrak's chapel. Beneath the thorns, so faint you could
take it for a stain, a second mark has been stitched: a closed eye.

8044.name: The Shop

north.description: To the north lies The Back Room.

east.description: To the east lies The Eastern Wall Road.

8044.description:
The shop is cramped and ill lit, hung with coils of rope, tin lanterns,
bundles of tallow candles and sacks of coarse salt. A counter of black
oak runs across the room, scarred by countless coins and knives. Dust
lies thick on the shelves, and the grey day filters through a single
grimy window. The door opens east to the wall road, and a curtained
doorway leads north into the back room.

8045.name: The Back Room

south.description: To the south lies The Shop.

8045.description:
The back room is a windowless storeroom, stacked to the rafters with
crates, kegs and barrels bound in hoops of rusting iron. A table holds a
ledger gone mouldy at the edges and a candle drowned in its own wax.
Everything smells of damp sacking, tar and spilled brine. The only way
out is the doorway south to the shop.

8046.name: Keep Street

north.description: To the north lies Keep Street.

east.description: To the east lies The Eastern Wall Road Meets Keep Street.

8046.description:
Keep Street climbs gently here toward the high ground, its cobbles
sharply worn into ridges by centuries of hooves. Tall houses with leaded
windows lean over the road, each with a bolt on the door and a pot of
withered herbs on the sill. The air is cold and tastes of coal smoke.
The street runs north toward the keep, and the wall road lies east.

8047.name: Keep Street

south.description: To the south lies Keep Street.

west.description: To the west lies The Entrance To Mishrak Keep.

8047.description:
The street bends sharply here as it nears the keep, whose dark curtain
wall rises over the rooftops in heavy courses of grey stone. A rusted
lamp bracket juts from a corner, bent as if someone had tried to wrench
it off. Fallen slates lie in the gutters. Keep Street runs south back
toward the wall road, and west leads to the keep's entrance.

8048.name: The Forge

east.description: To the east lies The Eastern Wall Road.

8048.description:
The forge is an open-fronted shed with a hearth of blackened brick and a
hooded flue, its bellows hung on a beam and its anvil bolted to a stump.
Racks of tongs, hammers and half-forged blades line the posts. Coals
glow orange in the fire pit, and the air smells of scorch and quenching
water. The way out is east to the wall road.

8049.name: The Northern Wall Road

east.description: To the east lies The Eastern Wall Road Meets The Northern Wall Road.

west.description: To the west lies The Northern Wall Road.

8049.description:
The road bends slightly here as the wall curves toward its corner, and
the cobbles are cracked and heaved by roots from some forgotten garden.
A watchman's chalk tally covers a stretch of wall in neat rows of
strokes. The air is cold and tastes of smoke. Ahead east lies the corner
of the Eastern Wall Road, and west the road runs on along the Northern
Wall Road.

8050.name: The Eastern Wall Road Meets The Southern Wall Road

north.description: To the north lies The Eastern Wall Road.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Wall Road.

8050.description:
Here the Eastern Wall Road meets the Southern Wall Road at a rounded
corner, where the wall curves tight and a squat corner tower leans over
the cobbles. The tower's door is padlocked and its slit windows look
down on the junction. Bleak light falls on puddles. One way leads north
along the wall and the other runs west.

8051.name: The Eastern Wall Road

north.description: To the north lies The Eastern Wall Road.

south.description: To the south lies The Eastern Wall Road Meets The Southern Wall Road.

8051.description:
The Eastern Wall Road narrows between a sagging tannery and the grey
wall, and the sour smell of hides hangs thick. A line of rope across the
street still holds a few strips of leather that never dry in this damp.
Dark stains patch the setts. The road runs north and south from here.

8052.name: The Eastern Wall Road

north.description: To the north lies The Eastern Wall Road.

south.description: To the south lies The Eastern Wall Road.

west.description: To the west lies The Shop.

8052.description:
A shop door with a faded sign of crossed scales opens in the house
fronts here, its lintel carved with a pattern of vines. Handprints of
soot mark the doorpost, and a worn step has been polished by years of
boots. The Eastern Wall Road continues north and south from the doorway,
while the shop lies west.

8053.name: The Eastern Wall Road

north.description: To the north lies The Eastern Wall Road Meets Keep Street.

south.description: To the south lies The Eastern Wall Road.

8053.description:
The wall road runs quiet here, with cobbles clean-swept and doorsteps
scrubbed, as if the residents wished to be left unnoticed. A water
barrel stands beneath a downpipe, its surface skinned with scum. Chimney
smoke is the only sign of life. The road goes north and south along the
wall.

8054.name: The Eastern Wall Road Meets Keep Street

north.description: To the north lies The Eastern Wall Road.

east.description: To the east lies Inside The Eastern Gate Of Mishrak.

south.description: To the south lies The Eastern Wall Road.

west.description: To the west lies Keep Street.

8054.description:
Keep Street meets the Eastern Wall Road at a wide, windy corner, with
the dark mass of the keep rising beyond the roofs. A watch-post stands
on the corner with a lamp burning in the window even in day. The road
goes north and south along the wall, the gate stands east, and Keep
Street runs west toward the keep. Faces vanish from shutters as you
look.

8055.name: The Eastern Wall Road

north.description: To the north lies The Eastern Wall Road.

south.description: To the south lies The Eastern Wall Road Meets Keep Street.

8055.description:
The Eastern Wall Road runs here between the blank flank of the wall and
tall shuttered houses, with a gutter down its centre choked with fallen
leaves. A baker's sign hangs rusted and creaking, though the shop
beneath it has been shut for years. The smell of cold ashes lingers. The
road leads north toward the forge and gate and south to the junction
with Keep Street.

8056.name: The Eastern Wall Road

north.description: To the north lies The Eastern Wall Road Meets The Northern Wall Road.

east.description: To the east lies Inside The Eastern Gate Of Mishrak.

south.description: To the south lies The Eastern Wall Road.

west.description: To the west lies The Forge.

8056.description:
The Eastern Wall Road widens before the gate, its setts churned to mud
by hooves and wheels. Across the way a low shed stands open to the road,
the red glow of a forge showing from inside, and the smell of hot iron
mixes with horse dung and wet wool. The road goes north to the corner,
south along the wall, and east to the gate. Grey light picks out the
iron studs of the gate doors.

8057.name: The Eastern Wall Road Meets The Northern Wall Road

south.description: To the south lies The Eastern Wall Road.

west.description: To the west lies The Northern Wall Road.

down.description: To the down lies The Hole.

8057.description:
At this corner of the town wall two wall roads meet, and in the middle
of the cobbles a ragged hole has opened, its edge crumbling and ringed
with a rope hung on rusty stakes. Raw earth and old stone show in its
sides, and a faint chill rises out of it. The Eastern Wall Road leads
south from here and the Northern Wall Road west. Something below
breathes a stale, mouldy air.

8058.name: Western Grand Stairway

north.description: To the north lies Western Edge Of The Landing.

up.description: To the up lies Third Floor Landing.

8058.description:
Narrow and steep, this grand stair winds up in a tight curve, its stone
treads dished in the middle and slick with damp. An iron rail follows
the wall, flaking rust onto the palm. Weak light drops from a window
high above. Back north the landing waits, and the stair climbs on.

8059.name: Western Edge Of The Landing

east.description: To the east lies The Second Floor Landing.

south.description: To the south lies Western Grand Stairway.

8059.description:
This end of the landing is dim and draughty, the balustrade broken in
one spot and mended with a length of rope. A faded tapestry of a stag
hunt hangs on the wall, its colours eaten to browns and greys. Dust
drifts across the tiles. The landing runs east toward the hallway, and
the stairs descend south.

8060.name: The Guest Closet

east.description: To the east lies Guest Quarters.

8060.description:
The closet is hardly bigger than a cupboard, its walls lined with pegs
and shelves smelling of cedar and mildew. A few empty hangers hang from
a rail, clicking together in a draught from nowhere. A single shelf
holds a cracked chamber pot and a bundle of mouse-chewed linen. The only
way out is east to the guest quarters.

8061.name: Guest Quarters

east.description: To the east lies A Long Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies The Guest Closet.

8061.description:
The guest quarters are a dim chamber with a high carved bed hung with
moth-eaten curtains, a washstand and a dressing table with a clouded
mirror. Dust lies undisturbed on the coverlet. The window is shuttered,
and the room smells of lavender gone sour. The hallway lies east, and a
narrow door west leads to a closet.

8062.name: A Long Hallway

south.description: To the south lies A Long Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies Guest Quarters.

8062.description:
At the end of the hallway the boards give way to flagstones, cold and
slightly damp, with a lone window set in a deep embrasure. A candle
sconce hangs bare on the wall and the plaster has flaked in long strips.
A door west stands in carved oak, leading to the guest quarters. The
hallway returns south.

8063.name: A Long Hallway

north.description: To the north lies A Long Hallway.

east.description: To the east lies The Servants' Room.

south.description: To the south lies A Long Hallway.

8063.description:
The hallway has a worn runner of red carpet gone brown with age, running
between panelled walls hung with empty portrait frames. A draught moves
the dust in slow curls. Doors lead off the hallway, one open east into a
small servants' room. The hallway goes on north and returns south.

8064.name: A Long Hallway

north.description: To the north lies A Long Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies The Second Floor Landing.

down.description: To the down lies Bottom Of The Narrow Stairs.

8064.description:
A long hallway runs through the keep's upper floor, floored with dark
boards that creak at every step and lit by narrow windows of thick
greenish glass. Faded tapestries sag along the walls, their pictures
lost in dust. The stairs lead down to the lobby, the hallway runs north
into shadow, and south it opens to a landing.

8065.name: The Second Floor Landing

north.description: To the north lies A Long Hallway.

east.description: To the east lies Eastern Edge Of The Landing.

west.description: To the west lies Western Edge Of The Landing.

8065.description:
A broad landing opens off the hallway, its balustrade of black carved
wood overlooking a hall below and its floor tiled in a faded pattern of
red and cream. High windows admit a pale and sullen light, and the dust
of years lies on the rail. Grand stairways descend on either hand. The
hallway lies north, and the landing's edges stretch east and west.

8066.name: Eastern Grand Stairway

north.description: To the north lies Eastern Edge Of The Landing.

up.description: To the up lies Third Floor Landing.

8066.description:
A grand stairway curves from the landing, its wide oak steps carpeted in
a runner worn bare at the centre. Carved newel posts end in snarling
beasts whose paint has long flaked off. A chill drifts up the stairwell,
smelling of old stone. The landing is north, and the stair rises further
to the next floor.

8067.name: Eastern Edge Of The Landing

south.description: To the south lies Eastern Grand Stairway.

west.description: To the west lies The Second Floor Landing.

8067.description:
This end of the landing is a quiet alcove, its tiles cracked and its
balustrade leaning slightly outward. A tall window of leaded glass
overlooks the court, the panes smeared with grime. A rack of dead
candles stands in the corner. The landing continues west, and the
stairway descends south.

8069.name: The Servants' Room

east.description: To the east lies The Balcony.

west.description: To the west lies A Long Hallway.

8069.description:
The servants' room has a row of rough pallets along one wall, each with
a folded blanket and a small tin box beneath. A chipped basin stands
beside a door, and the plaster is smudged with soot where candles stood.
It smells of cold porridge and wool. The hallway lies west, and an open
doorway east leads to a balcony.

8070.name: The Balcony

west.description: To the west lies The Servants' Room.

8070.description:
A narrow stone balcony juts from the keep wall, railed with a crumbling
balustrade and wet with drizzle. Far below, the roofs of Mishrak huddle
under chimney smoke, and beyond them the wall and the dark line of the
forest. The wind is strong and carries the slow toll of the chapel bell.
The only way back is west into the servants' room.

8071.name: The Eastern Bedroom

west.description: To the west lies Third Floor Landing.

8071.description:
The bedroom is small and neat, though the dust is thick on every
surface. A narrow bed stands against the wall beneath a cracked mirror,
and a wardrobe's door hangs by one hinge. A faint smell of tallow and
cold ashes clings to the air. The door opens west onto the landing.

8072.name: The Southern Bedroom

north.description: To the north lies Third Floor Landing.

8072.description:
This bedroom has a single window facing the court, its shutters nailed
and its glass cobwebbed. A bed with a bare mattress sits beside a heavy
table scarred by ink and knife-points. Torn papers rustle in the hearth.
The door north leads out to the landing.

8073.name: Third Floor Landing

north.description: To the north lies The Northern Bedroom.

east.description: To the east lies The Eastern Bedroom.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Bedroom.

west.description: To the west lies The Western Bedroom.

down.description: To the down lies The Balcony.

8073.description:
The third-floor landing is a small square hall, ringed with doors of
dark wood, one on each side. Threadbare carpets lie on boards that groan
underfoot, and a single high window lets in grey light. A dusty lamp
hangs from a ceiling hook on a chain. Doors lead north, east, south and
west to the bedrooms.

8074.name: The Northern Bedroom

south.description: To the south lies Third Floor Landing.

8074.description:
The bedroom is large and chilly, with a canopied bed sagging beneath a
mildewed spread and heavy drapes drawn across the window. A cold hearth
holds a nest of old ash, and a chest at the foot of the bed lies open
and empty. The air tastes of damp and abandoned things. The door leads
back south to the landing.

8075.name: The Western Bedroom

east.description: To the east lies Third Floor Landing.

8075.description:
The western bedroom is the smallest of the four, and its single window
is blocked with a tapestry gone black with damp. A narrow bed stands
under the slope of the ceiling, and a washstand holds a basin cracked
clean through. The floorboards have shrunk and gaped, and the cold comes
up through them. The only door opens east onto the landing.

8076.name: The Hole

up.description: To the up lies The Western Wall Road.

8076.description:
You are in a ragged pit dug into the ground, the sides a mixture of
black soil, knotted roots and fallen stones. Brown daylight falls from
the opening above, where the wall road lies, and a few tree roots dangle
down like dead fingers. The floor is damp and trampled, with a chill
that seeps into the bones. The only way out is up.

8077.name: The Office

south.description: To the south lies Keep Street.

west.description: To the west lies The Operating Room.

8077.description:
The office is a narrow, plain room, with a heavy desk, a stool and a
shelf of ledgers bound in grey cloth. A high window lets in dim light,
and a smoky lamp stands on the desk with a half-written page beneath it.
Ink has dried in a black pool in the well. The street door lies south,
and a narrow door west leads to another room.

8078.name: The Cellar

up.description: To the up lies A Ruined House.

8078.description:
The cellar is a low, damp room of rough brick, its roof beams sagging
and its floor wet with seep. Empty barrels lie on their sides and
shelves slump under rotten sacks. A smell of mould and old wine hangs
thick. The only way out is up the steps into the ruined house.

8079.name: The Secret Room

east.description: To the east lies The Catacombs.

8079.description:
A cramped stone chamber lies beneath the chapel, its roof so low you
must stoop and its walls scratched with sigils in rusty red. A table of
black wood holds stubs of candles and a stained bowl. The air is cold
and heavy, and it smells of old blood and wax. A passage leads east into
dark.

extra_descs.sigils scratches walls:
The sigils are scratched deep and daubed with something rust-brown. They
circle a single shape, a closed eye above a bowl, repeated over and over
until the pattern swallows the wall.

8080.name: The Catacombs

north.description: To the north lies The Catacombs.

east.description: To the east lies The Catacombs.

south.description: To the south lies The Catacombs.

west.description: To the west lies The Catacombs.

up.description: To the up lies The Chapel Of Mishrak.

8080.description:
A low vaulted passage runs between rows of burial niches, each one
stacked with yellowed bones and dust. The mortar is cracked and wet, and
a faint draught moves along the floor. Every opening here seems to lead
to the same dark stretch of vault in the north, east, south or west. A
narrow stair climbs up toward the chapel.

8081.name: The Hole

up.description: To the up lies The Southern Wall Road.

8081.description:
A shaft of raw earth and broken masonry drops from the road above,
forming a rough pit whose floor is littered with rubble and fallen
cobbles. The sides are shored in places with warped timbers, and cold
air creeps along the bottom, smelling of lime and wet ash. A pale square
of sky shows high overhead, and a climb up is the only way out.

8082.name: The Hole

up.description: To the up lies The Eastern Wall Road Meets The Northern Wall Road.

8082.description:
You are at the bottom of a shaft of loose earth and broken stone, which
has been dug or has fallen from the road overhead. Tree roots and rusty
nails stick from the clay walls, and the floor is a clutter of rubble.
Grey light sifts down through the opening above. Only a scramble up the
crumbling side gets you out.

8083.name: Inside The Eastern Gate Of Mishrak

east.description: To the east lies Outside The Eastern Gate of Mishrak.

west.description: To the west lies The Eastern Wall Road.

8083.description:
You stand in the shadow of the eastern gate, where a vaulted passage
cuts through the thickness of the wall. Its great oak doors are hung
with iron and pitted with the marks of ages of weather, and a portcullis
sits raised in its slot above. Wet cobbles lead east through the doors
to the road outside, and the town lies back west. Bootmarks and ruts
cover the floor of the gatehouse.

8084.name: Outside The Eastern Gate of Mishrak

east.description: To the east lies The Forested Road.

west.description: To the west lies Inside The Eastern Gate Of Mishrak.

8084.description:
Beyond the gate doors the ground opens to a trampled apron of mud and
gravel before the town wall, scattered with straw and broken crate
boards. The wall looms overhead, black with damp, and arrow slits stare
down from it like closed eyes. The forested road begins east, narrow
between dark trunks, and the gate lies back west. A signpost leans, its
arms weathered blank.

8085.name: The Forested Road

east.description: To the east lies The Forested Road.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Eastern Gate of Mishrak.

8085.description:
The road enters the trees here, a rutted track of brown earth between
oaks and tall dark firs. Mist hangs in the branches and the light is
thin, the colour of old pewter. Fallen cones and wet leaves cover the
verges. The road runs on east into the wood and back west toward the
town gate.

8086.name: The Forested Road

east.description: To the east lies The Intersection In The Forested Road.

west.description: To the west lies The Forested Road.

8086.description:
The forest closes in tighter here, roots crossing the road like
knuckles, and the trunks stand so close that the track seems a tunnel.
Water drips steadily from the boughs. A wheel rut has filled with black
water, and the leaf-mould smells sweet and old. The Forested Road
continues east to a crossing and west toward Mishrak.

8087.name: The Intersection In The Forested Road

north.description: To the north lies The End Of The Forested Road.

east.description: To the east lies The Forested Road.

west.description: To the west lies The Forested Road.

8087.description:
A crossing of tracks lies in a small clearing where a toppled oak has
let some grey daylight through. The main road goes on east and west,
while a lesser way leads north toward the end of the road. Wagon wheels
have cut deep, and someone has hacked a crude mark into a trunk. Ferns
grow thick at the verge, dripping.

8088.name: The Forested Road

east.description: To the east lies The Forested Road.

west.description: To the west lies The Intersection In The Forested Road.

8088.description:
East of the crossing the road runs between ancient beeches whose smooth
grey trunks rise like pillars, and the canopy makes a ceiling of
rattling leaves. Boot prints in the mud wander from the road into the
undergrowth and stop. A chill wind pushes through the trunks. The
Forested Road leads west to the crossing and east deeper into the wood.

8094.name: The End Of The Forested Road

south.description: To the south lies The Intersection In The Forested Road.

8094.description:
The road gives out in a dead end among the pines, ending in a ring of
trodden earth where wagons once turned. A cairn of mossy stones stands
in the middle, topped with a rusted horseshoe nailed to a post. Needles
blanket the ground and silence presses in. The only way back is the
track south to the crossing.

extra_descs.cairn horseshoe stones post:
The cairn is a waist-high heap of mossy fieldstones, each placed by a
passing traveller. The horseshoe on the post above it is worn thin with
rust.

8095.name: The Forested Road

west.description: To the west lies The Forested Road.

8095.description:
The road fades here into a track of bare roots and bracken, and just
ahead the trees draw together in a wall of thorn and bramble. A rotten
gatepost sags beside the path, its crossbar long gone, and ivy has
swallowed half of it. Everything is damp and the light is poor. The only
way out is back west along the Forested Road.

8096.name: The Abode Of Donnchadh

east.description: To the east lies Chapel Street Meets Market Street.

south.description: To the south lies Eastern Altar.

8096.description:
The abode is a cramped, cluttered room with a narrow cot, a shelf of
tattered scrolls and a round table piled with candle ends and half-eaten
crusts. A shuttered window lets in a thread of light, and the whole
place smells of ink, old wool and tallow. A string of dried herbs hangs
above the hearth. The door opens east onto the chapel forecourt.

8097.name: The Catacombs

north.description: To the north lies The Catacombs.

east.description: To the east lies The Catacombs.

south.description: To the south lies The Catacombs.

west.description: To the west lies The Catacombs.

up.description: To the up lies The Catacombs.

down.description: To the down lies The Catacombs.

8097.description:
Here the tunnels of the dead run deeper than any mason intended, and the
walls are patched with bone and brick in a crazed mosaic. A line of old
candle-black runs along the vault as though someone had followed it with
a flame. Water drips on stone with slow patience. You can go north,
south, east or west, up or down, though all look the same.

extra_descs.niches bones mosaic:
The bones in the niches have been sorted and arranged, skulls with
skulls and long bones in neat criss-crossed stacks. Here and there a
skull has been set facing the wall.

8098.name: The Catacombs

north.description: To the north lies The Catacombs.

east.description: To the east lies The Catacombs.

south.description: To the south lies The Catacombs.

west.description: To the west lies The Catacombs.

up.description: To the up lies The Catacombs.

down.description: To the down lies The Catacombs.

8098.description:
The catacomb passages branch and rejoin here like a root system, vault
after vault of stone bones. Fallen plaster lies in white drifts, and
ribs and skulls peer from the niches. The air is thick and still, and
distant footsteps echo with no clear source. Passages lead north, south,
east and west, and others slope up and down.

208099.name: The Operating Room

east.description: To the east lies The Office.

208099.description:
A cold stone table dominates this small room, with a drain in the floor
beneath it and a rack of curved blades and saws on the wall. A lamp on a
bracket gives a harsh, yellow light that shows dark stains on the flags.
The room smells of vinegar and old iron. The only way out is the door
east to the office.

641900.name: townsman man wary mishrak
641900.long_desc: A wary townsman keeps close to the wall, glancing at every shuttered window.
641900.description:
He is thin and grey-faced, with a patched coat pulled tight and a
walking stick he holds like a weapon. His eyes slide away from yours,
and he looks like a man who has learned to hear nothing and see less.

641901.name: wolf grey forest
641901.long_desc: A gaunt grey wolf pads between the trunks beside the road, watching with pale eyes.
641901.description:
The wolf's ribs show beneath a matted coat, and its lip is drawn back
from yellow teeth. It moves with the slow patience of a beast that has
been hunting travellers on the Forested Road all winter.

641902.name: cultist hooded cult acolyte
641902.long_desc: A hooded cultist stands in the gloom, murmuring under his breath.
641902.description:
He wears a robe of undyed grey wool with the hood pulled low, and a
closed eye daubed in red on his brow. A black-bladed dagger hangs at his
belt, and his lips never stop moving over some unwholesome prayer.

641903.name: enforcer cultist cult mail blackened
641903.long_desc: A blackened cult enforcer stands guard in the dark, his hand on a heavy blade.
641903.description:
A broad man in soot-black chain, his face hidden by a visor of beaten
iron. The closed eye of the cult is cut into his breastplate. He moves
like a soldier, and he does not seem to need to breathe.

641904.name: skeleton warden bone
641904.long_desc: A bone warden skeleton stands motionless between the niches, its empty sockets turned on you.
641904.description:
A tall skeleton clad in the rotted remains of a sexton's cloak, with
bone plates wired across its chest. It holds a rusted halberd and a
shield of yellowed bone, and it clatters faintly as it turns.

641905.name: deacon orrin vash cultist priest
641905.long_desc: Deacon Orrin Vash sits at the desk in the head priest's chair, smiling thinly.
641905.description:
The deacon wears the grey vestments of the chapel, but a heavy cult ring
glints on his hand and a red thread is knotted at his wrist. His smile
is polite and his eyes are cold, and a curved knife lies by his hand.

641906.name: maelgrim high priest pale cultist
641906.short_desc: Maelgrim the Pale, high priest of the cult
641906.long_desc: Maelgrim the Pale, high priest of the cult, stands among the dead with a smoking censer in his hand.
641906.description:
A gaunt man in robes the colour of old bone, with skin that has never
seen the sun and a closed eye tattooed in red across his brow. He swings
a heavy censer on a chain, and the smoke that pours from it smells of
grave earth. The bones in the niches seem to lean toward him as he
speaks.

741900.name: dagger black bladed cult
741900.room_desc: A black-bladed dagger lies here, its hilt wound with red cord.
741900.description: The blade is blackened iron, wicked and thin. A closed eye is etched into the pommel.

741901.name: hauberk chain mail blackened
741901.room_desc: A blackened chain hauberk lies in a heap here.
741901.description: Soot-dark links, heavy and well made, with an eye cut into the breast ring. It smells faintly of grave earth.

741902.name: shield bone plate yellowed
741902.room_desc: A yellowed shield of wired bone plates lies here.
741902.description: Plates of old bone are wired to a wooden frame, sturdier than they look. It rattles faintly when moved.

741903.name: ring silver chapel tarnished
741903.room_desc: A tarnished silver ring lies here.
741903.description: A heavy silver ring bearing the thorn sign of the chapel of Mishrak, with a tiny closed eye cut on the inside of the band.

741904.name: censer mace chain priest high
741904.room_desc: A heavy censer on a chain lies here, still faintly smoking.
741904.description: A brass censer shaped like a skull, hung on a short chain from an iron haft. It hits like a hammer and leaves a smell of grave earth.
